hook: Your phone screen reacts to a banana.
title: Your Phone Screen Reacts to a Banana
description:
Capacitive touchscreens sense anything conductive, not just fingers. Fruit contains a lot of water, so a banana or other fruit can move the cursor on many phones. Try it now with whatever fruit you have.

#Shorts #TechFacts #PhoneTricks
